document_metadata.title: 21、INT. POOL HALL -- BAR
document_metadata.summary: Elmore warns against the deadly risk of pursuing Israel, suspected of being a mob informant; Dupree reveals Israel's location in Lake Tahoe with a half-day lead before it spreads.

entities.name: Elmore criticizes the group's continued conversation
entities.description: Elmore expresses disdain for the ongoing discussion, calling it idiotic, and turns to Deeks to voice his opinion about their past as underperforming ex-cops.

entities.name: Deeks comments on their current employment and drinking habits
entities.description: Deeks reflects on their present situation, noting they are working low-quality casino jobs to pay bills and that their work monitoring slot machines deteriorated once they began drinking.

entities.name: Dupree reveals the expiring bond on Israel
entities.description: Dupree interrupts the conversation to inform the group that the bond for Israel will expire in eighteen hours, after which there will be no restrictions on apprehending him.

entities.name: Dupree discloses Israel's bail was posted by his law firm
entities.description: In response to Deeks' question, Dupree reveals that Israel’s bail was paid by his own law firm, the same firm that employed Dupree, and that Israel has disappeared since being released.

entities.description: A group of former police officers meets at a bar for dollar drafts, using the setting as a space to discuss their past, current struggles, and an urgent matter involving a fugitive named Israel.

entities.name: Dupree
entities.description: An ex-cop who reveals critical information about the expiring bond on Israel and discloses that Israel's bail was posted by his own law firm, which also employed him.
entities.summary: A narrator details Lavernel's life, Buddy Israel's rise in show business and mob ties, the transmission of sleight of hand skills, an incompetent pool player exposing the Carlotta organization, and the Tremor Brothers' notoriety, with Donald McGarey identified as their target.

entities.name: Israel
entities.description: A person whose bond is about to expire, having been released on bail posted by his law firm, after which he disappeared.
entities.summary: A man targeted by the Sparazza Family for ransom and a million-dollar contract is in hiding at the Nomad Hotel under an alias, evading capture after skipping bail, while his actions draw police scrutiny toward the Sparazza and Carlotta organizations; he is emotionally distressed over a jacket stained and tied to his deceased mother.

entities.name: law firm

entities.name: cigarettes

entities.name: Elmore argues against pursuing Israel due to extreme danger from the mob
entities.description: Elmore reasons that if Israel is the informant, the mob is actively hunting him with lethal force, making any involvement in the skip trace a near-suicidal risk.

entities.name: Dupree smokes and responds to Elmore's refusal with dry acceptance
entities.description: After Elmore rejects the mission, Dupree calmly blows smoke, flicks ash, and remarks, 'So I guess you're not going,' signaling his understanding of Elmore's decision.

entities.name: Elmore ridicules the idea of pursuing Israel with a hopeless analogy
entities.description: Elmore scoffs at the mission's feasibility, comparing it to taking Fort Knox with a slingshot or chasing Hitler into Hell, emphasizing its futility and danger.

document_metadata.title: 65、INT. BATHROOM -- DAY
document_metadata.summary: Warren violently performs martial arts near Elmore's face, unresponsive to his pleas, while Margie intervenes and removes Warren; a news report reveals Jack Dupree as one of two men killed, with a third person missing.

entities.name: Margie Turlock carries Hollis Elmore into the bathroom
entities.description: Margie Turlock, a substantial woman and part-time registered nurse, physically carries the shrunken, fetal-like Hollis Elmore into a bathroom and places him into a lukewarm bath filled with grey water.

entities.name: Margie Turlock instructs Warren to fetch a hot blanket and heating bag
entities.description: Margie asks her grandson Warren to retrieve a hot blanket and a heating bag from under the sink in her bathroom to help warm Hollis Elmore.

entities.name: Warren performs aggressive karate kicks while holding an ice cream sandwich
entities.description: Warren, after placing an ice cream sandwich in his mouth, begins hopping and violently kicking the wall with intense ferocity, displaying disturbing physical behavior in response to his grandmother's request.

entities.name: Margie Turlock laughs at Warren's violent outburst
entities.description: Margie responds with amusement and affection to Warren's aggressive kicking and behavior, calling him 'angel-butt' and promising to rub his feet.

entities.name: Hollis Elmore observes medication-lined sink with growing dread
entities.description: While being bathed, Hollis Elmore notices the sink basin is lined with various psychiatric medications such as Ritalin and Thorazine, and reacts with increasing fear and anxiety.

entities.name: Margie Turlock decides to retrieve the heating items herself
entities.description: After Warren fails to comply and continues his violent play, Margie abandons her request and decides to get the hot blanket and heating bag herself.

entities.name: bathroom
entities.description: A domestic interior space where Margie Turlock places Hollis Elmore into a bath and instructs Warren to retrieve items, serving as the primary setting for the scene.

entities.name: Hollis Elmore
entities.description: A shrunken, shriveled, fetal-like man being carried and bathed by Margie Turlock, showing signs of physical frailty and emotional distress.
entities.summary: A former Vegas vice cop, associated with Jack Dupree and Pistol Pete Deeks, is found severely hypothermic and critically ill, later identified posthumously by severed fingers; he confronts Darwin Tremor armed before collapsing, while Margie Turlock cares for his shrunken, frail body.

entities.name: Margie Turlock
entities.description: A 63-year-old part-time registered nurse and souvenir shop owner, physically strong and grandmotherly, who cares for Hollis Elmore and interacts with her grandson Warren.
entities.summary: A 63-year-old nurse and shop owner cares for Hollis Elmore, brings supplies, discusses recent violence, and interacts with her grandson Warren.

entities.name: Warren
entities.description: Margie Turlock's grandson, a boy with braces who exhibits childlike behavior, delayed speech processing, and sudden bursts of violent physical energy, particularly involving karate kicks.
entities.summary:
Margie Turlock's grandson, a boy with braces who exhibits childlike behavior, delayed speech processing, and sudden bursts of violent physical energy, particularly involving karate kicks.
The grandson of Margie Turlock, who enters with her carrying nunchukas, and is met with hostility by Elmore.

entities.description: A heated blanket requested by Margie Turlock to warm Hollis Elmore, stored under the sink in her bathroom.

entities.name: heating bag
entities.description: A heating device kept under the sink in Margie's bathroom, intended to help warm Hollis Elmore during his bath.

entities.name: ice cream sandwich
entities.description: A frozen dessert that Warren licks but does not bite, later using it as a prop before performing aggressive karate kicks.

entities.name: anti-depressants
entities.description: Medications including Ritalin and Thorazine found lined up in the bathroom sink, indicating psychiatric treatment possibly related to Hollis Elmore or others in the household.

entities.name: registered nurse
entities.description: A professional medical role referenced by Margie Turlock to assert authority and competence in caring for Hollis Elmore.

entities.name: Warren performs martial arts kata over Hollis Elmore in the bathtub
entities.description: Warren assumes a martial arts stance over the helpless Hollis Elmore in the tub and begins violently executing a series of precise punches and kicks, stopping just short of Elmore's face while in a frenzied state.

entities.name: Warren's ice cream sandwich falls into the bathtub
entities.description: As Warren opens his mouth to speak during his martial arts display, the ice cream sandwich he was holding tumbles out and lands in the bathtub.

entities.name: Hollis Elmore pleads with Warren to stop the attack
entities.description: Hollis Elmore, unable to move or defend himself, attempts to speak and raises his partial hand in a desperate, futile plea for Warren to stop his violent performance.

entities.name: Margie Turlock reenters bathroom and physically restrains Warren
entities.description: Margie returns to the bathroom, scolds her grandson, and forcefully restrains him with a hard backhand and her arms, dragging him out of the room as he cries out.

entities.name: Warren feigns an attack on Margie Turlock
entities.description: After being confronted by Margie, Warren squares up and pretends to deliver a blow to her face, prompting her to strike and restrain him.

entities.name: Hollis Elmore is left alone and exposed in the bathroom
entities.description: After Warren is removed, Hollis Elmore remains naked and trembling in the bathroom, turning his head to look toward the other room where a television newscast is playing.

entities.name: Television broadcasts live report on double homicide at lakeside parking lot
entities.description: A live news report plays on the television showing a reporter at the scene of a double homicide, identifying one victim as Jack Dupree and mentioning the disappearance of a third person.
